description.en: Loads a compiled script file (.nutb) and runs it in the context table named by the second argument; CallEvent uses it to load an event script into "subev_ctx". An empty path unloads the script loaded before.
Script file, e.g. "data/script/event/ev42010100.nutb", or "" to unload.
Name of the context table, e.g. "subev_ctx".

1 once loaded (true for the unload case).
null if the load failed, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
